headline: Nikhil Merchant files SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition in SWAN CORP LIMITED
sum: Nikhil Merchant has disclosed a substantial acquisition of shares in SWAN CORP LIMITED under SEBI Takeover Regulations, fulfilling the Regulation 31(4) continuous disclosure obligation with NSE.
detail: Nikhil Merchant submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE. Regulation 31(4) mandates continuous disclosure by persons having crossed the 5% shareholding threshold or those moving toward a mandatory offer trigger (25% threshold). The filing was archived on NSE's corporate disclosure system on 16 Jun 2026. Without access to the full disclosure document, the exact stake percentage, transaction value, and terms remain unconfirmed from secondary sources.
